profile_text: Looking for a full-time position in software engineering with a focus on embedded Linux, drivers, and low-level systems. MSc in Computer Engineering (EPITA - GISTRE) in Systems / Embedded. Fluent in French and English (TOEIC 915, C1). Interests: watchmaking, music, hiking/running, cooking.

entity_description_overrides.proj-ad638299: Built a Rate Monotonic scheduler in Heptagon, a dataflow language that compiles nodes to deterministic C step functions with no heap allocation, deployed it to RPi 3 via UART bootloader.
entity_description_overrides.proj-2a5cd1e4: Built STM32F429ZI embedded system acting as a UART command server using libgapcom. Implemented a 4-level log subsystem and an MPU6050 gyroscope driver over I2C with FIFO reads.
